title: Level 1/2/3 Sound Healing Course in Canggu, Bali
metaTitle: Best Sound Healing Course in Canggu Bali
metaDescription: Best Sound Healing Course in Canggu, Bali - Level 1/2/3 / Gain the deepest knowledge and skills to become a professional sound healer.
summary: Our three-level integrated Sound Healing Course guides you from complete beginner to accomplished practitioner in one program.
intro: Welcome to Bali Yoga School, where the timeless art of sound healing flourishes in the vibrant heart of Canggu. Nestled among lush rice paddies and just moments from pristine beaches, our sanctuary offers the perfect environment to immerse yourself in the transformative power of sound vibrations.

You will get the chance to work and experience with a vast array of traditional and contemporary sound healing instruments, including Tibetan and crystal singing bowls, therapeutic gongs, shamanic drums, precision tuned chimes, calibrated tuning forks, and sacred voice techniques. This practical experience method makes sure that you not only acquire theoretical knowledge but also the confident technical skills that make you practise effectively.

Therapeutic sound frequencies are created by practitioners using carefully selected instruments, including singing bowls, gongs, drums, chimes, flutes, and tuning forks. Each instrument possesses its vibrations that vibrate with the body and energy centres.
durationStatements: Length of the Course: 6 days / 5 nights

keyFacts.label: Certification
keyFacts.value: Certified by International Yoga Organisation & Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society (as stated in 'What's Included')

curriculum.title: Level 1 Syllabus
items: Introduction to Tibetan sound healing therapy and its benefits
Concept and types of singing bowls
How to select the singing bowls
Technique to hold the bowls
Technique to rub and hit the bowls
Introduction to the concept of aura, how to clean the aura and how to seal the aura
Aura protection for yourself
Mind relaxing technique
Therapy for digestive system
Water charging technique and its benefits in drinking
How to facilitate a professional healing
Detail introduction about the safety rules for conducting the session

curriculum.title: Level 2 Syllabus
items: Detailed introduction about the chakras
Identifying your blocked chakras or effective areas and clearing the blockage with the help of bowls
How to use the power of sound to clear and cleanse your space
Detail introduction about 7 chakra therapy i.e. chakra balancing
Mental therapy
Physical therapies
7 chakra balancing, inclusive of all chakras

curriculum.title: Level 3 Syllabus
items: Introduction to sound bath and how to conduct the sound bath therapy
Back pain therapy
Whole body massage
Relationship therapy
Family therapy
Introduction to other instruments like shamanic drum, ocean drum, 9 bar chimes, rain stick, tingsha

schedule.heading: Course Length / Dates / Fees
schedule.note: We offer the Level 1/2/3 Sound Healing Course in Canggu, Bali throughout the year. Please contact us to check availabilities of your desired dates.

extras.label: Booking deposit
extras.detail: To book for the course, please deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD.

inclusions: Private accommodation with 24h hot water availability (with accommodation course options)
Mentioned yoga asanas / meditation / sound healing classes
Course materials (1 school bag / 1 school t-shirt / 1 sound healing manual book / 1 notebook / 1 pen)
All other materials for activities (available at the school to use in class only)
This course is certified by International Yoga Organisation & Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society.
Free high-speed WiFi throughout the campus

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: Check in: On the day 1st at 12:00 pm
Check out: On the last day at 12:00 pm

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Deposits are non-refundable, but can be transferred to other upcoming courses at Bali Yoga School in any locations. The deposit is valid for a lifetime.

policies.title: Management Authority
items: The management team is authorised to make the necessary changes in the daily schedule if needed. These adjustments ensure smooth coordination of classes and the best experience for all participants.

policies.title: Course Booking & Confirmation
items: To book for the course, please deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD. An official confirmation letter for your program will be sent shortly after successful payment of the yoga retreat fees.

policies.title: Asanas Class
items: The purpose of the asana classes is to support your body and mind in the healing process during your healing course journey. These sessions promote personal well-being rather than provide professional-level training in asanas or alignment techniques.

policies.title: 1 Hour Self Practice
items: You can engage in a one-hour self-practice session in the HYA Healing Studio using available instruments. Any damage to equipment during practice must be covered by you.

policies.title: Important Note
items: The school reserves the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.
